name: MHS GENESIS (Electronic Health Record)
description: DoD enterprise EHR deployment replacing AHLTA/CHCS across all Military Treatment Facilities worldwide. Fully deployed at 3,200+ locations. Oct 2025: $570M in enterprise services tasks awarded to Leidos. Dec 2025: DHA released draft strategy for MHS GENESIS Follow-On, separating program management from product/service support.

name: Community Care Network (CCN) Next Gen
vendor: TBD — solicitation active, proposals due April 3, 2026
description: Next-generation VA community care IDIQ contracts replacing current CCN regional contracts (Regions 1-6) for veteran healthcare through community providers. Posted Dec 15, 2025 on SAM.gov (36C10G26R0003), updated March 13, 2026. Multiple-Award IDIQ for national and regional health plans.

name: T4NG / T4NG2 (VA IT Services)
description: VA's primary enterprise IT services vehicle. T4NG ($22.3B ceiling) is being superseded by T4NG2 ($60.7B ceiling, awarded late 2023). Task orders under T4NG2 began March 2026 after multi-year protest resolution (18 protests filed 2024-2025, now resolved).
sb_note: Partial set-aside for small businesses under T4NG2

name: Federal Electronic Health Record Modernization (FEHRM)
description: Joint DoD-VA effort to deploy a single, common federal EHR for seamless health data sharing between departments. FY2026 budget request: $3.495B for VA EHR portion. Congress withholding 30% pending updated lifecycle cost estimate by mid-2026. FEHRM office fully operational coordinating joint DoD-VA interoperability.

name: VA EHR Modernization (EHRM)
description: VA's enterprise EHR modernization. Multi-year pause ending with deployments restarting April 2026 at 4 Michigan VA Medical Centers (Detroit, Saginaw, Ann Arbor, Battle Creek). 9 additional sites follow in 2026 (Ohio, Indiana, Kentucky, Alaska). Strategy shifted to wave-based regional deployments. Congress withholding 30% of FY2026 funding ($3.495B requested) pending updated lifecycle cost estimate. Oracle Health exercised 3rd option period in 2025.

name: TRICARE Managed Care Support — T-5 (MCS)
description: T-5 generation went live January 1, 2025, replacing T-2017 contracts. Current regional managed care support for 9.6M+ TRICARE beneficiaries. Dec 2025: DHA exercised Option Period Two — $7.34B for Humana, $719.4M for Evernorth pharmacy.

name: Enterprise Intelligence & Data Solutions (EIDS)
vendor: SpinSys-Diné (PMO COOP), Koniag IT Systems ($94.4M AWS cloud, 8(a) sole-source)
description: DHA analytics and data solutions contract for health surveillance, population health, and operational intelligence. EIDS AOI 4 (Data Applications) competing under PEO DHMS Competitive Solutions Opening (CSO). DHA modernizing EIDS acquisition via CSO pathway — AWS GovCloud + DevSecOps focus.
sb_note: Multiple award vehicle with small business holders across task orders

name: Defense Health Agency Telehealth Programs
description: Telehealth expansion across the Military Health System including virtual health platforms and remote monitoring. Amwell Converge platform replacing MHS Video Connect. OMEIS Sources Sought issued Jan 2026 for tele-radiology in disconnected/deployed environments.
sb_note: Various task orders available for small business competition

name: VA Health Connect / IHT 2.0
vendor: Tribility, Titan-Auxo, Rios Partners, Reefpoint Group, Prometheus Federal Services, Blue Water Thinking, Arrow ARC, Agile4Vets
description: VA Health Connect is VA's 24/7 virtual care, clinical triage, and tele-emergency program. Underlying vehicle: VHA Integrated Healthcare Transformation (IHT) 2.0 — $14B, 10-year SDVOSB set-aside IDIQ, awarded late 2025.

name: Military Health System Enterprise Imaging
description: Enterprise-wide medical imaging modernization including PACS, VNA, and AI-assisted diagnostic imaging. Key OEMs: Philips Healthcare (maintenance sole-source, March 2026), D-Scope Systems (video imaging archive, Feb 2026). Upcoming: OMEIS multi-award IDIQ for operational tele-radiology with AI-assisted clinical decision support.

name: IHS Health IT Modernization (RPMS Replacement)
description: Enterprise EHR modernization replacing legacy RPMS across tribal and federal health facilities. Parallel in scope to VA EHRM. GDIT awarded Nov 2023.

name: TPharm5 (TRICARE Pharmacy)
description: TRICARE pharmacy benefit management. Express Scripts manages Rx benefits, claims, mail-order pharmacy, and retail network for all TRICARE beneficiaries. CY2026 option exercise: $719.4M.

name: CDM DEFEND (Health Data Cybersecurity)
description: Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation DEFEND program. Protects health data and IT infrastructure across all HHS agencies including CMS, CDC, NIH, FDA. Implements zero trust architecture and continuous monitoring.

name: DHA Enterprise Generative AI
description: First Impact Level 5 generative AI platform authorized for PHI in the Military Health System. Enterprise-wide deployment for clinical decision support and administrative AI. Launched Dec 2025.
sb_note: Ask Sage is a small business

name: TEFCA / RCE (Health Information Exchange)
description: Trusted Exchange Framework and Common Agreement — foundational nationwide health information exchange mandated by 21st Century Cures Act. Sequoia Project operates as Recognized Coordinating Entity (RCE), enabling interoperability across DoD, VA, CMS, and all federal health systems.

name: CMS Cloud Infrastructure (OCI)
description: CMS migrating mission-critical Medicare claims processing to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure on FedRAMP High. Announced Feb 2026. Consolidates legacy mainframe workloads as part of CMS modernization initiative.

name: JOMIS (MHS GENESIS Theater)
description: Joint Operational Medicine Information Systems — deployed/theater version of MHS GENESIS for military operations. Installed on USNS Mercy, integrating with MedCOP for real-time force health tracking. Supports disconnected/low-bandwidth.

name: DHA Zero Trust 2.0 / GSP
description: FY2026 initiative consolidating expiring health IT infrastructure contracts under a Global Service Provider model with Zero Trust 2.0 architecture. Covers network ops, endpoint security, cloud infrastructure for the MHS.

name: PEO DHMS CSO (Competitive Solutions Opening)
description: Non-traditional acquisition pathway for health IT innovation. Active AOIs: 1b (AI/ML/NLP), 4 (Data Applications — AWS GovCloud + DevSecOps). Rolling submissions accepted through June 2026.
sb_note: Open to small businesses and non-traditional contractors

name: CMS Rural Health Transformation
description: CMS $50B program strengthening rural healthcare infrastructure across all 50 states. Includes telehealth expansion, cybersecurity, AI workflow modernization, and provider network development. Awarded Dec 2025.
sb_note: State-level awards include small business subcontracting

name: MPSM (Medicare Payment Systems Modernization)
description: Legacy Medicare claims system transformation. Multiple task orders for modernizing Part A, B, and D payment processing.

name: CDC DCIPHER (Disease Surveillance)
agency: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
description: Palantir Foundry for disease surveillance, outbreak detection, and population health monitoring. Originally COVID-19, expanded to broader surveillance.

name: SSA DCPS2 (Disability Claims Processing)
description: Disability claims processing modernization with heavy health records integration. Processes medical evidence for disability determinations.

name: NIH STRIDES (Cloud for Biomedical Data)
description: Discounted commercial cloud access for NIH-funded biomedical research, genomics processing, and AI/ML workloads.

name: CDC DIBBs (Data Integration Building Blocks)
agency: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)
description: Modular data integration platform for state/local/tribal public health agencies. Standardizes disease reporting and lab results. Deploying to 30% of STLTs by 2026.

name: MHS GENESIS Follow-On
description: Follow-on to current MHS GENESIS EHR contract. DHA draft strategy (Dec 2025) separates program management from product/service support into distinct contract vehicles.

name: Medicare Claims Processing AI Modernization
description: CMS initiative to unify and modernize Medicare claims processing using AI and automation. Competition launched March 2026. Replaces fragmented legacy claims adjudication infrastructure.

name: DHA Enterprise Data Catalog
description: ML-powered enterprise data catalog for MHS. Automated metadata discovery, data lineage tracking, and quality scoring across DHA data assets.
